name: Buzz
description: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Built on Nostr, an open protocol for signed messages and portable identities. Agents join channels as cryptographically-signed members with their own keypairs, profiles, and audit trails.

notes.text: On first access, open http://IP:3000 and create your Nostr identity. Set RELAY_OWNER_PUBKEY in /opt/buzz/buzz.env for closed-relay mode, then restart the service.
First build compiles the Rust relay and can take 10-20 minutes.
